Cancellation uses B=UA, U commuting with the flag, the same actual zero-reflection tape, separately justified controlled clean-work domains, full terminal measurement/reset and the conditional global minus. Supporting proof preserves the transported invariant and does not assert dirty-scratch off-domain equality.

Reflection cost theorem is for positive integer degree, additive retained templates, Clifford good reflection and charged zero-T resets. Two affine conditions give all-degree dominance and sharp ratio. Same-history extension additionally requires identical implemented probability, initial information, tolerance, confidence and policy; fallbacks and non-reflection primitives require a separate comparison.

Protected-cap monotonicity and same finite-pool ordering are distinguished from adaptive mean cost. Numerical conditioning wins every stipulated-mesh mean; paired histories are not actual financial flags or expected-runtime estimates.

Positive raw measure masses, actual nodes within CDF cells, tail moment, dispersion-weighted derivative envelopes and degree-four finite-moment closure are retained. Cauchy refinement is correctly conditional on nonnegative measures and is not claimed as a new generic integration principle.

Self-financing gain includes reinvested dividends, the admissible bounded-below class is explicit, the finite-horizon square-integrability calculation is valid, and call-spread Greeks have correct signs and units.

The inverse maximum principle, affine lift, mollification and odd periodic extension justify the exact-arithmetic bound for the original kinked payoff. Domain and interpolation allowances are separate. The conservative order and bump rates follow from the displayed bounds. Floating-point DST/Thomas checks are explicitly not interval certificates.

Pathwise first derivatives use a valid dominating envelope; ordinary gamma uses the correct second density derivative; mixed gamma includes the density boundary contribution. Finite raw uncertainty ranges, Chebyshev gamma bound, independent-pair accounting and pilot/control limitations are consistent.

The L2 completeness/closedness construction, nearest point proof, L1 conditional extension, Jensen/tower identities, singular control geometry and independent-pilot excess-risk decomposition are valid. Joint projection and cost accounting are correctly distinguished from finite-pilot or runtime dominance.

MLE rank failure, orthogonal-rotation Wishart/Student pivots, physical-drift correction, fixed-horizon drift floor and shrinkage limits are checked. The vega-sign factorisation identifies the unique possible interior maximum. Full image propagation preserves coverage. The zero-coverage summary needs C1, while its proof is correct.

Scatter error follows from the centring projection/reverse triangle inequality; strict outward CDF inequalities correctly bracket quantiles; clamped maximum avoids uncertain membership branches. The returned certificate guarantee is joint success-and-exclusion, not conditional-on-success coverage. The separate randomized numerical composition uses valid conditional premises and a union bound.

Total-return stock accounting is coherent. The loss is uncentred physical MSE with fixed risk-neutral capital. Positive definiteness, strict positive unrestricted risk, compact existence/uniqueness, finite face enumeration, polyhedral KKT including B=0 and budget shadow-price derivations are valid. The unrestricted benchmark is appropriately identified as a formal L2 relaxation.

The three-gain Gram representation, exact outward feasibility scaling, Lagrange weak-dual lower bound and determinant/trace holding-distance bound are valid. Stored, repaired and refined holdings and rounded-price versus exact-fair-price losses remain distinct.
